posts.text: I’m here at our southern border. Thanks to President Trump and House Republicans, THE BORDER IS CLOSED! President Trump was right: We didn’t need new laws, we just needed a new president!

Spent the afternoon at the southern border with some of our GREAT Texas Republican congressional candidates and @BPUnion President Paul Perez. Thanks to President Trump and House Republicans, our border is SEALED - another promise made, promise kept! @teixeiramark25 @TheAKGuy

Joe Biden let 10 MILLION illegal aliens into the USA. Thanks to President Trump and Republicans in Congress, our border is now SEALED! I visited President @realDonaldTrump’s border and if I had to describe it in one word: serene. It’s completely closed, empty, and secure. Turns out all we needed was a new president!
#TX09, vote for @AlexMealerTX on November 3rd!

.@TheAKGuy is spot on: Texas can NEVER return to the days of the Biden Border Crisis that allowed more than 10 MILLION illegals into our country. Brandon Herrera is an America First Patriot and fighter for Texans. #TX23, vote for Brandon on November 3rd! 🇺🇸

context.html: Where: McAllen, in the Rio Grande Valley, per the Washington Sun's Oct. 13 report. Emmer confirmed it himself in an interview clip he posted Oct. 14. Until the Sun's report, the pin here was our estimate. The trip included a border tour, a roundtable with local business officials, a meeting with the Border Patrol union and a session with local ranchers, plus fundraisers, the Sun reported. "CLOSED" and "SEALED": CBP reported 8,870 Border Patrol apprehensions at the southwest border in August, 5% fewer than in July and 94% below the Biden administration's monthly average. Crossings are at historic lows; they are not zero. The primaries: In two of these races, his committees had backed the Republican incumbent in the primary. His campaign and leadership PAC gave Rep. Dan Crenshaw $7,000 in February; Steve Toth beat Crenshaw in March. His committees gave Rep. Tony Gonzales $12,000 this cycle; Gonzales quit the TX-23 race in March, and Brandon Herrera became the nominee.

races.note: The only one of the nine races with an incumbent on the ballot, and the only one Cook rates in Democrats' favor. Trump pardoned Cuellar in December 2025, before his bribery trial.

posts.text: Started off the day in Lowcountry supporting our friend, @JennyHoneycutt. South Carolina knows what's at stake in 32 days: COMMON SENSE vs COMMUNISM! Glad to have @realBrandonGill, @AustinScott4GA, and @EdGallrein on the road with us!

context.html: The race: The seat is open because Rep. Nancy Mace ran for governor; she finished fifth in the June 9 primary. Honeycutt, a Charleston County Council member and attorney, won the June 23 Republican runoff with about 54%. Lacore, a retired Navy vice admiral who led the Navy Reserve, won the Democratic runoff with 52%. Emmer's campaign and leadership PAC gave Honeycutt's campaign $7,000 on June 25, two days after the runoff. The phrase: In his Sept. 9 speech to the Republican midterm convention, he called this "an election between common sense and communism."

context.html: The race: Cook moved VA-01 from Lean R to Toss Up on Oct. 9. Its earlier Solid D rating was for a redrawn map that the Virginia Supreme Court struck down on May 8, so the race is running on the old district lines. Cook's summary: Taylor "benefits from a district that's clearly trending left, but Wittman has a history of overperforming electorally." A Washington Post-Schar School poll released Oct. 1 found Taylor at 50% and Wittman at 46% among likely voters, within the poll's 4.5-point margin of error.

posts.text: My friend and the next Congressman for Maine's Second Congressional District, @MainePaulLePage, and I are on the ground in Lewiston today discussing the millions of dollars in FRAUD stolen from the good people of Maine. Here we are outside the former Gateway Community Services building - a crooked organization that is responsible for nearly $2 MILLION in Medicaid fraud. Maine, we need you to send Paul to Congress to help us fight back against fraudsters and hold corrupt Democrats accountable once and for all!

Proud to stand with @MainePaulLePage in Maine! You don't come here to take advantage of America's generosity or live off handouts. You come here to contribute. Paul has spent his career fighting for that, and fighting the fraudsters ripping off taxpayers.

context.html: The record on Gateway: Maine DHHS suspended the provider's MaineCare payments in December 2025, citing a "credible allegation of fraud," and upheld the suspension in May 2026. State audits found more than $1.7 million in overpayments between 2015 and 2022. Gateway denies the allegations and has appealed. Neither report mentions criminal charges. Follow-up: In a Fox News interview from the Lewiston stop, Emmer said, "Fraud in Minnesota is the number one issue." The race: Cook moved ME-02 from Likely R to Lean R on Oct. 9.
